---
title: "La articulación de la protesta"
subtitle: "*Los condenados de la pantalla (2012)* -- Hito Steyerl"
author: "Presenta:  Jorge E. Bracamontes G."
format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    margin: 0.1
    transition: zoom
    transition-speed: slow
    theme: night
    hash: true
    center: true
    css: [fondo.css]
    incremental: true
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-image: "images/fn.png"
      data-background-size: "cover"
      data-background-opacity: "1.0"
---









<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  if (window.location.search.match(/print-pdf/gi)) return;

  const synth = window.speechSynthesis;
  let utterance = null;
  let paused = false;
  let voicesReady = false;

  const fullscreenButton = document.createElement('button');
  fullscreenButton.id = 'fullscreenButton';
  fullscreenButton.textContent = 'Pantalla completa';
  fullscreenButton.style.cssText = `
    position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; z-index: 1000;
    padding: 12px 20px; background-color: #ff7300; color: #ffffcc;
    border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(fullscreenButton);

  const getSpanishVoice = () => {
    const voices = synth.getVoices();
    return voices.find(v => v.lang === 'es-MX') ||
           voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('es-')) ||
           voices[0] ||
           null;
  };

  const cleanText = (text) =>
    text
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/([.!?])\s*\./g, '$1')
      .trim();

  const getReadableText = (el) => {
    const clone = el.cloneNode(true);

    clone.querySelectorAll('ul, ol').forEach(list => list.remove());
    clone.querySelectorAll('script, style, button, .controls, .progress, .slide-number').forEach(x => x.remove());

    return cleanText(clone.textContent || '');
  };

  const speakText = (text) => {
    const finalText = cleanText(text);
    if (!finalText) return;

    synth.cancel();

    utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(finalText);
    utterance.lang = 'es-MX';
    utterance.voice = getSpanishVoice();
    utterance.rate = 0.95;
    utterance.pitch = 1;

    synth.speak(utterance);
  };

  const isReadable = (el) => {
    if (!el) return false;

    const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return false;

    if (el.classList.contains('fragment') && !el.classList.contains('visible')) return false;

    return true;
  };

  const readCurrentSlide = () => {
    const currentSlide =
      document.querySelector('section.present:not(.stack)') ||
      document.querySelector('section.stack.present > section.present');

    if (!currentSlide) return;

    const elements = currentSlide.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, li, blockquote');

    let totalText = '';

    elements.forEach(el => {
      if (!isReadable(el)) return;

      const text = getReadableText(el);
      if (text) totalText += text + '. ';
    });

    speakText(totalText);
  };

  if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined') {
    Reveal.on('ready', readCurrentSlide);

    Reveal.on('slidechanged', () => {
      paused = false;
      readCurrentSlide();
    });

    Reveal.on('fragmentshown', event => {
      const text = getReadableText(event.fragment);
      speakText(text);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'q') {
      if (paused) {
        synth.resume();
      } else {
        synth.pause();
      }
      paused = !paused;
    }
  });

  fullscreenButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();
    } else {
      await document.exitFullscreen?.();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
    fullscreenButton.style.display = document.fullscreenElement ? 'none' : 'block';
  });

  synth.onvoiceschanged = () => {
    voicesReady = true;
  };
});
</script>
